mapper.select: SELECT CLIENT_KEY AS key, TO_CHAR(REQ_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS request_date, DEPT_CODE AS department_code, PHONE AS phone, CALLBACK_NUMBER AS callback_number, TEMPLATE_CODE, NVL(KV_DATA, '')||NVL(KV_DATA2, '') AS kv_data_string, CAMPAIGN_ID, PUSH_USER_ID, FILE_DATA AS file_data_string, KISA_ORIGCODE AS kisa_origin_code, RCS_AGENCY_ID, RCS_AGENCY_KEY, RCS_BRAND_KEY FROM ${tableName} WHERE MSG_STATUS = 'ready' AND TRAFFIC_TYPE = #{lineType} AND REQ_DATE < SYSDATE AND ROWNUM <= 1000
